syllables.name: The long stance
syllables.desc: Feet wide, weight back, lead hand out: measuring.

syllables.name: Tall and light
syllables.desc: A short, upright stance on small steps.

syllables.name: Stepping in
syllables.desc: The lead foot reaches and the body follows.

syllables.name: Lunge and throw
syllables.desc: The torso drives forward over the lead leg: most punches live here.

syllables.name: Shuffle forward
syllables.desc: Both feet slide forward together, closing distance.

syllables.name: Square up and walk
syllables.desc: Squaring to the opponent and walking: a reset.

syllables.name: Feet together
syllables.desc: The feet come together: a step-through or a switch.

syllables.name: Kick
syllables.desc: A leg leaves the floor at speed.
